notes: Six own pages read, all HTTP 200 and not thin; https://ramsoft.com/ redirects to https://www.ramsoft.com/. PowerServer and OmegaAI are the vendor's index aliases, so 'PowerServer RIS/PACS', 'PowerServer PACS' and 'OmegaAI RIS/PACS/VNA' mentions were treated as name mentions; LITE PACS, TELE PLUS, Blume, Gateway, Omega RIS and KloudPACS were coded as module names. Combined 'PowerServer / OmegaAI' cloud-native lines were coded under C01 (OmegaAI is cloud-native); the single line calling PowerServer alone cloud-native is C06, unverifiable, because RamSoft labels PowerServer cloud-based and OmegaAI cloud-native without saying PowerServer is not cloud-native. C07 (PowerServer fully web-based) rests on the history page's 2003 'fully web-based platform' line; a reviewer may prefer unverifiable. C17 treats per-study pricing as a pay-as-you-go basis. The home page itself shows both '750+ Practices' and '800 + Practices worldwide'. The q4 line about 'flat-rate or right-sized alternatives' naming RamSoft was treated as too vague to code. Single-database architecture, billing, AI features, 'Progressive Loading' and speed figures were treated as capability descriptions. No claim is wrong or stale, so no cited page was read for causes. Pass 2 (8 Oct 2026): no browser read exists for RamSoft and no page was blocked or thin, so nothing was re-classed; the six snapshots were re-checked for C06, C08, C12, C13, C21 and C22 and still do not settle them (only OmegaAI is called cloud-native; no hybrid, Omega RIS, KloudPACS or PowerServer site count appears). The 19 gap lines are shortlist or best-for lines, capability lines, or generic cloud-versus-on-premise remarks whose RamSoft cloud-native content is already an instance of C01 for the same answers; 'RamSoft + eRAD' names two vendors without stating ownership, so it was not coded. The comparison tables (including the q5 Google AI Mode deployment row 'Cloud (SaaS)') carry only cells already coded under C01, C03 to C05 and C09 to C10, so no claim or instance was added. No claim is wrong or stale, so the consistency check changed nothing.
